# Haumesser

A weapon, in English: the captions from the `en` table, the English
original hidden because the card is English. Invented for this deck; the
deck prints `de` and leaves it out.

```card-forge
card:
  system: dcc
  card-type: equipment
  language: en
data:
  name: Chopping knife
  original-name: Chopping knife
  type: Weapon
  damage: 1d6
  range: 10/20/30
  cost: 4 gp
  notes:
    - May be thrown; on a fumble it is lost in the undergrowth.
  reference: Core Rulebook p. 70
```
